faq.question: Details
faq.answer: asleep Original is a 25 cm high mattress made from 4 different foam layers and a premium cover. The mattress is made in Lithuania using certified, carefully selected materials. Every element of the construction — from the internal foams to the removable cover — is chosen with quality, durability and everyday use in mind.
materials: Premium cover with TENCEL™ — soft, pleasant to the touch and highly breathable
Memory Foam — adapts to the contours of your body and provides a comfortable enveloping feel
asleep Support Foam — a responsive layer that quickly reacts to body movement
High-quality HR foam — for resilient comfort and even body support
Firm foam base — for mattress stability and durability
Non-slip bottom layer — helps keep the mattress securely in place

sections.heading: Delivery
sections.body: We deliver your asleep mattress to your home free of charge, conveniently packed in a compact box. Standard delivery takes 3–7 business days. Prefer to receive your mattress later? You can select a more convenient delivery date during checkout.

sections.heading: Free returns
sections.body: Once the mattress has been unpacked, you won't need to fit it back into the box. If you decide to return asleep, we'll arrange free collection of the fully expanded mattress from your home. Once we receive the returned mattress, we'll refund the full amount paid to your account.

sections.heading: 120-night sleep trial
sections.body: We give you 120 nights to try asleep where it matters most — in your own home. If you decide during this period that the mattress isn't right for you, register a return and we'll arrange free collection. Returned mattresses are never sold as new. Mattresses in suitable condition may be donated to charity or sold as refurbished.

sections.heading: 10-year warranty
sections.body: asleep mattresses come with a 10-year warranty, giving you long-term confidence in the mattress's quality and durability.

sections.heading: Certifications
sections.body: The foams used in the asleep mattress are CertiPUR certified. The CertiPUR certification programme sets strict requirements for polyurethane foam composition, safety and emissions:
bullets: Contains no heavy metals such as mercury, lead or cadmium
Complies with strict restrictions on the use of phthalates
Low emissions of volatile organic compounds (VOCs)

sections.heading: Care
sections.body: The removable top section of the asleep mattress cover can be washed at 40°C, making it easy to keep the mattress clean and fresh and maintain a hygienic sleep environment.

infoSlider.heading: A mattress designed for better sleep

slides.title: Thoughtful 4-layer construction
slides.body: asleep Original consists of 4 carefully selected foam layers with different properties. Memory Foam, high-density responsive foam, HR foam and a stable base work together to provide comfort every night.

slides.title: Different comfort for each person
slides.body: Prefer a firmer mattress while your partner likes it softer? asleep allows each side of the mattress to be adjusted individually, so neither of you has to compromise.

slides.title: Natural spinal alignment
slides.body: asleep's 4-layer construction helps distribute body weight evenly and reduce pressure in sensitive areas. Whether you sleep on your back, side or stomach, the mattress helps your body maintain a natural position throughout the night.

slides.title: Premium-quality materials
slides.body: We selected materials we can rely on: a premium cover with TENCEL™ fibre, Memory Foam and high-quality foam layers. The foams used in asleep are CertiPUR certified, and the mattress is made in Lithuania.

tencel.title: Tencel
tencel.body: Tencel fibre is made from responsibly sourced wood and has a soft, pleasant feel.
tencel.bodyExtra: In the asleep top cover, Tencel is blended with viscose and polyester. This combination balances a pleasant surface feel, practicality and durability. The removable top section of the cover can be washed at 40°C.
tencel.mediaAlt: Close-up of the Tencel cover texture
advantages: Helps maintain a comfortable sleep microclimate

hypersupport.title: asleep Support Foam
hypersupport.body: asleep Support Foam does more than support your body. The responsive foam reacts quickly to movement and helps create a comfortable, stable sleep surface.
advantages: Excellent point elasticity for body support

memoryFoam.title: Memory Foam
memoryFoam.body: asleep Memory Foam adapts to the shape of your body and helps distribute body weight evenly. Responding to body heat, the foam conforms to your individual contours, helping reduce pressure in sensitive areas and creating a comfortable, enveloping feel.
advantages: Helps reduce pressure in sensitive areas

coldFoamSoft.title: HR Comfort Foam
coldFoamSoft.body: The responsive HR foam layer gives the mattress structure and helps the body maintain a natural position during sleep. High-resilience foam reacts quickly to movement and distributes load evenly, helping comfort remain consistent throughout the night.
advantages: Helps maintain a natural body position
Helps maintain mattress shape and stability

coldFoamFirm.title: Base Support Foam
coldFoamFirm.body: The firm asleep base foam layer provides a stable foundation and helps maintain the mattress structure. The resilient foam is designed to retain its properties and provide stability for years.
advantages: Stable foundation for the entire mattress

comfortZones.title: Comfort zones
comfortZones.body: Together with a testing centre, we developed 7 unique comfort zones to provide support where your body needs it. Different parts of the body require different levels of support.
advantages: Helps maintain the spine's natural S-shape

nonSlip.title: Non-slip layer
nonSlip.body: We've thought carefully about the underside of the mattress too. The non-slip layer helps limit movement and keeps the mattress securely in place.
nonSlip.mediaAlt: Non-slip layer on the bottom of the mattress

cover.title: Cover
cover.body: The woven cover is made from premium textiles. Its fibres provide good ventilation. The blue section can be washed at 40°C. Do not tumble dry.

blocks.title: Made in Lithuania
blocks.body: We're proud that asleep mattresses are designed and made in Lithuania. We work with local manufacturing partners and carefully select every material and construction element. Local production keeps us close to the entire process — from the first prototypes to the finished mattress — and helps us maintain the quality we expect from every asleep.

blocks.title: Developed together with VU medical students
blocks.body: When developing asleep, our goal wasn't simply to make another mattress. Together with Vilnius University medical students, we analysed sleep ergonomics, different materials and their combinations, and how mattress construction can adapt to different people's needs. We combined these insights with prototyping and testing different foam combinations. Step by step, this shaped the multi-layer asleep construction we use today.

blocks.title: Intensively tested
blocks.body: We want asleep to remain just as comfortable after years of use as it is on the first night. That's why the foams used in the mattress are tested for durability, resilience and resistance to long-term loading. Every asleep layer uses high-quality, CertiPUR-certified foams that meet defined quality and safety requirements. This gives us confidence not only in how asleep feels today, but in how it will perform for years to come.

items.question: Construction and materials
items.answer:
Mattress height: 25 cm

Asleep consists of:
- Top cover (1 cm)
- Memory Foam (3 cm)
- asleep Support Foam (2 cm)
- HR Comfort Foam (10 cm)
- asleep Base Foam (10 cm)
- Non-slip bottom cover layer

Densities
ASLEEP Support Foam: D60
Memory Foam: D45
HR Comfort Foam: D30

Cover composition
Top/white side: 19% lyocell (Tencel) / 19% viscose / 62% polyester
Non-slip underside: 100% polyester

items.question: 120-night free trial
items.answer: We're confident in asleep's quality, so we give you 120 nights to try the mattress at home with no risk. You'll have plenty of time to adjust to your new mattress, find the configuration that suits you best and decide whether asleep is right for you. If you're not completely satisfied within 120 nights, simply contact us. We'll collect the mattress from your home free of charge and refund the full amount you paid. The 120-night trial is available once per customer and applies to the first asleep mattress order. Full trial and return terms can be found in our returns policy.

items.question: I'm choosing between two single mattresses and one double mattress
items.answer: If you choose two single mattresses, each will have its own cover, so you may feel a gap between them. A double asleep mattress is made as one mattress, while the firmness of each side can still be adjusted individually. Prefer it firmer while your partner likes it softer? There's no need to compromise — each of you can choose the comfort that suits you best.

items.question: Can you take away my old mattress?
items.answer: We currently don't offer an old mattress removal service. The asleep mattress is delivered compactly packed in a box, so no specialised furniture transport is required. We recommend arranging bulky waste collection for your old mattress or taking it to your nearest bulky waste collection site. Check your local waste management provider's website for collection conditions and the nearest location.

items.question: Washable cover
items.answer:
The asleep mattress cover is removable. The white top section with TENCEL™ can be washed at 40°C.

Cover composition
Top / white section: 19% lyocell (TENCEL™) / 19% viscose / 62% polyester
Non-slip bottom section: 100% polyester

Important! Always follow the care instructions on the cover label before washing.

items.question: Suitable for all bed types
items.answer:
asleep is a versatile mattress. It is suitable for slatted bases, solid bases, boxspring beds and adjustable bed bases. The most important thing is that the base is stable and in good condition.

Make sure your current bed base is in good condition and shows no signs of:

• sagging
• unevenness
• damaged or worn parts

Your bed base can have a significant impact on the comfort and sleep quality of your new asleep mattress.

items.question: Can I sleep on asleep straight away?
items.answer:
After unpacking, the asleep mattress may need up to 48 hours to fully regain its shape. However, you can sleep on it straight away!

Please also pay attention to your bed base. It should be in good condition — flat, stable, free from sagging and without signs of wear. The condition of your bed base can have a significant impact on the comfort of your new asleep mattress.

items.question: Can I choose a delivery date?
items.answer: Yes. During checkout, you can use the delivery calendar to select your preferred shipping date.
